agents.name: Claude Code
agents.quote:
# Don't change the title of my terminal tab, because it doesn't change back when I exit claude.
export CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1

also.quote: Claude did this with my direction.
Also, Claude made the code changes, and did a good job!

review_style.value: A person owns and reviews every commit, Claude or not
review_style.quote: Every commit is owned by a person who has vouched for the quality of the commit, and every commit is reviewed by a person who has also vouched for it. Making a commit with Claude's help doesn't change that.

also.quote: Claude can write wrong code. New contributors can write wrong code. What matters is what you do with that code after it's been written.
You should make a detailed plan and confirm it with me.

When showing me code to approve running, ALWAYS provide a one-sentence sumamry
of what the code does and why you are running it. Tell me the goal of the code.

harness.value: Claude Code in a terminal tab, LSP tool on, prompt suggestions off
harness.quote:
# Don't suggest the next prompt.
export CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION=false

# https://karanbansal.in/blog/claude-code-lsp/
export ENABLE_LSP_TOOL=1

rules_files.value: Global CLAUDE.md importing nedbat-main.md (56 lines) from his dotfiles

signature.caption: Claude fixes its own rules
signature.why: Our pick: when a workflow goes wrong, his CLAUDE.md has Claude work out why and propose changes to its own instructions.
signature.quote:
Be introspective. When something goes wrong with a workflow or process, think
carefully about why it happened. Offer to discuss the problem, and suggest
changes to instructions that could prevent it in the future.

archetype.why: Makes Claude plan and get his sign-off first, and keeps his fun projects AI-free.

signature_quote.value: Another choice I made: no AI.
signature_quote.more: I like writing programs. I get a deeper sense of the thing I am building when I have my fingers in the clay.
